designer-initial.summary: Selected a diversity-compliant medium EIT image-generation and Doctor-review availability coordinator with an exact 9/21/20/7 semantic inventory, two sole state owners, cooperating qualification and decision owners, a reachable Doctor-open versus newer-batch priority conflict, and closed fault/reset/fresh-event paths.
questions_for_model: Can separate pre-state outputs and post-decision snapshots from the generation-slot and review-session state-owning Threads be realized in the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset without a combinational cycle, mirrored state, or central recomputation?
Can the flat decision and snapshot records use direct attributes and field-specific enum classifiers while retaining exactly 20 owner-local case anchors and constraining every field?
Can the deterministic analyzer exhaust exactly 2304 legal one-step evaluations plus every owner-local product and all seven multi-step scenarios while preserving evidence for distributed ownership?

diversity.selected_primary_scope: EIT image-generation and Doctor-review availability coordination, with acquisition represented only as an external upstream batch event
diversity.closest_baseline: Accepted medium replicate-1 EIT Acquisition Session Coordinator (run 20260813T234357Z-eit-acquisition-medium-r1-a1)
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The design removes monitoring start, preparation qualification, acquisition command, impedance-frame admission, and acquisition-session state from the boundary. It instead owns an external-generator feedback loop and Doctor review exposure through generation-slot and review-session states; it could compose with replicate 1 only across a post-acquisition batch event, so it is a separate controlled purpose rather than a split or renamed acquisition pipeline.

model-review.summary: The exact 9/21/20/7 allocation is realizable and contains no identity-wrapper owner.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit found a meaningful local relation for every credited usage: PART-01 has a 2/2 usability collapse; PART-02 classifies 24 feedback/state pairs as 6 no-result, 1 matched-A, 1 matched-B, and 16 faults; PART-03 has a 2/1 access collapse; PART-04 combines 48 feedback/state/reset tuples; PART-05 arbitrates a bounded 1152-tuple legal owner product; PART-06 and PART-07 apply state-dependent sole-writer transitions; PART-08 classifies six states to commands with 4/1/1 fibers; and PART-09 classifies eight legal state pairs to availability with 6/1/1 fibers plus notice precedence. Bijective enum mappings, record construction, and copied fields remain explicitly uncredited.

The current library supports System/Process/Thread/Data, typed DataPort, and directed PortConnection forms. The accepted medium replicate-1 EIT source uses the same state-output to arbiter to state-input feedback shape, publishes In(state) separately from post-state snapshots, and passed a fresh Sireum typecheck against library revision 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 with Well-formed!.
findings.requested_change: Realize one root System, one uncredited behavior-free Process, nine sibling semantic Threads, 21 Process-local semantic connections, and eight uncredited root/Process delegations for 29 raw PortConnection declarations. Use attribute members for all GUMBO-inspected record fields and give field-specific bijective enum mappings no semantic or owner credit.

findings.evidence: The exact bounded root space is 288 raw inputs across eight legal pre-state pairs, or 2304 evaluations. The current harness accepts a dependency-free analyzer only after source-hash agreement, status=passed, passed ownership records, matching metrics/analyzer evidence fields, zero reported gaps/overlaps/mismatches/violations, and all Boolean checks. The retained 10368-point medium EIT analyzer reran in 0.19 seconds under the same 180-second timeout, demonstrating ample capacity.

The selected boundary, typed INT-01..INT-21 inventory, two exclusive state writers, owner-local CASE-01..CASE-20 allocation, seven scenarios, eight legal state pairs, reset/fresh-event closure, trace obligations, and deferred clinical/physical/executable claim boundary are internally closed and require no silent policy addition.

designer-resolution.summary: Model findings accepted with realization support kept uncredited; the unchanged 9/21/20/7 baseline is approved for generation.

model-generation.summary: Canonical EIT image-review availability coordinator passed both retained Sireum gates and exhaustive bounded analysis.

visualization.summary: Localized retained-view repair produced a native-readable, current-revision-valid overview with zero connector crossings, zero route-object collisions, exact source binding, and complete relevant traceability.
